title.narrative: Reconstruction and rehabilitation of the electricity transmission infrastructure Ukraine - Phase II

description.narrative: The Action is built on the existing Blending project ¿Reconstruction and rehabilitation of the electricity transmission infrastructure Ukraine¿ (NDICI-GEO-NEAR2023/447-915). The existing programme covers the costs incurred by the rehabilitation, repair, or new construction of system relevant substations, transmission lines and purchasing of necessary equipment in all relevant regions of Ukraine (¿build back better approach¿). Further measures include the physical protection of critical electricity infrastructure elements, like securing autotransformers, with concrete shelters.

From the narrative of the report is also unclear to know if there is double counting amongst the individuals reported under the different values. It is therefore decided to only report the highest value of all of them 8048 which corresponds to the number of youth registered and successfully completed skill development courses.
